title: Animal data table and squared bar chart sheet
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Changes of materials and animals including humans
source: Seeded from science/y5 lesson 26 (Animal data table and squared bar chart sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 26: Gestation and lifespan: reading animal data. To understand how gestation and lifespan vary between animals by reading data

blocks.text: Label both axes, choose a scale, and draw the bars with a ruler, with gaps between them.

questions.q: How many weeks longer is a human's gestation than a cat's?
questions.model: Find both numbers: human 40, cat 9. Subtract: 40 - 9 = 31. So 31 weeks longer.

questions.q: Which animal has the shortest lifespan?
Is it true that the biggest animal always lives longest? Use the data.
questions.a: No: the elephant is bigger but humans live longer in the table

questions.q: Draw a bar chart of the gestation times from the table on squared paper.
questions.a: Five bars: mouse 3, cat 9, human 40, horse 48, elephant 95 weeks
questions.model: Teacher sets up the axes on camera: animals along the bottom, weeks up the side in steps of 10, and draws the mouse bar.

questions.q: Write a pattern sentence: 'The bigger the mammal, the ...'
questions.a: The bigger the mammal, the longer the gestation.

questions.q: Convert the elephant's gestation into months (about 4 weeks a month).
Big question: why does an elephant take nearly two years to be born?
questions.a: It is very big, and bigger mammals usually need longer to grow before birth.
